decisions.reason: As a recent launch closely related to the firm's established machinery range, the compact dumper still has unresolved market potential and can be kept at relatively low strategic cost while sales evidence accumulates.
The articulated construction dumper extends the core offer in a growing industry, so real-options logic favors keeping this young product on the market until its demand becomes clearer.

Although more distant from the core range, the underground mine rescue vehicle serves a specialized niche with likely long buying cycles, so abandoning it after only one year would close an option before uncertainty has resolved.
Because the compact telescopic loader builds on the firm's existing capabilities and customer base, management would typically continue offering it for now rather than give up the option prematurely.
